description.en: Plugins maintained by smk-h for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: smk-h 维护的 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: MCP manager for DeepSeek Harness: per-workspace MCP servers, an opt-in on-demand tool broker, OAuth, plus skills, OpenSpec, session deletion, theme center and more.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 管理器：按工作区启停 MCP、按需工具代理、OAuth，另含技能、OpenSpec、删除会话、主题中心等十三项功能。

plugins.name: dsh-better-sidebar
plugins.title: Better Sidebar
plugins.description: Better Sidebar for DSH — file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, separate for every conversation. Also exposes a service other plugins use to register sidebar tabs and file viewers.

plugins.name: dsh-sessions-manager
plugins.title: Sessions Manager
plugins.description: DSH 会话管理插件：设置面板 + 侧栏双入口，归档 / 恢复 / 跨工作区移动 / 回收站（可恢复、批量清空、自动清理），子代理折叠与血缘、删父会话连带子代理，空白会话识别，按标题 · ID · 工作区搜索，带磁盘占用与会话详情。已适配 DSH 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1-rc.2。Session manager for DeepSeek Harness — archive / restore / move / trash lifecycle from both the settings

plugins.name: dsh-context
plugins.title: Context
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for context insight and management, with context dashboard and context command, for understanding how the context is made of, and how it evolves.
plugins.author: bowenliang123

plugins.name: dsh-memory-evolve
plugins.title: Memory Evolve
plugins.description: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来分层记忆（全局 / 用户 / 项目 / GIT 分支 / 每日）与自我进化（经验沉淀 + 技能自动创建）和技能管理、待办管理、CLI 调度（kimi/codex/grok/hermes 等外部 AI 统一调度）、临时信息便签，带 WebUI 管理界面。Hermes-style long-term memory, self-evolution, skills, todos and external CLI agent dispatch for DeepSeek Harness.
